About Me

My name is Manuely Feliz Portes, and I am passionate about rockets and propulsions. I am passionate about building things that push limits, whether it is designing combat robots, exploring advanced engineering concepts, or diving deep into complex systems just to understand how they work. I love hands-on creation, solving hard problems, and growing my technical abilities. My drive comes from curiosity, ambition, and a genuine excitement for engineering challenges.
